Proof in the paper: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns of the Rh/SiO2 and Rh-xP/SiO2 catalysts are shown in Figure 3. The Rh/SiO2 catalyst had two board peaks at 41.1° and 47.8°, which were attributed to Rh(111) and Rh(200), respectively (PDF no. 87-0714). The Rh-0.5P/SiO2 catalyst displayed only two peaks at 32.8° and 46.9°, corresponding to Rh2P(200) and Rh2P(220), respectively (PDF no. 77-0300). The TEM images and particle size distributions are shown in Figure 4. The HRTEM and HAADF-STEM images of the Rh-0.5P/SiO2 catalyst showed explicit crystal structures (Figure 4e). The d-spacing of labeled lattice fringes were 3.2, 2.8, and 1.9 Å, which corresponded to Rh2P(111), (200), and (220), respectively.
